class.name: TetraMaterial4D
class.description: TetraMaterial4D is a material for 4D tetrahedral meshes. It provides a user-friendly way to color tetrahedral meshes using single colors, per-vertex colors, per-cell colors, per-cell UVW coordinates, or 4D texture colors. TetraMaterial4D can be set on a [TetraMesh4D] resource to define how the tetrahedral mesh should be colored, and/or overridden on a specific [MeshInstance4D] node.

members.member: The single albedo color of the material. When the albedo source is set to [constant TETRA_COLOR_SOURCE_SINGLE_COLOR], this is the color of the entire tetrahedral mesh. If the albedo source is set to [constant TETRA_COLOR_SOURCE_PER_VERT_AND_SINGLE], [constant TETRA_COLOR_SOURCE_PER_CELL_AND_SINGLE], [constant TETRA_COLOR_SOURCE_TEXTURE3D_CELL_UVW_AND_SINGLE], or [constant TETRA_COLOR_SOURCE_TEXTURE4D_DIRECT_AND_SINGLE], this color is multiplied with the per-vertex, per-cell, per-cell UVW, or 4D texture colors, respectively.

The albedo color array of the material. This may be used to color various parts of the mesh, depending on the albedo source flags. Only used when any of the per-item color flags are set, meaning the [constant TETRA_COLOR_SOURCE_PER_VERT_ONLY], [constant TETRA_COLOR_SOURCE_PER_CELL_ONLY], [constant TETRA_COLOR_SOURCE_PER_VERT_AND_SINGLE], and [constant TETRA_COLOR_SOURCE_PER_CELL_AND_SINGLE] tetra color sources.

The albedo source of the material, an enum specific to tetrahedral meshes. Can be a single color, per-vertex, per-cell, per-cell UVW coordinates, 4D texture, or a combination of single color and the other color sources.

The albedo texture of the material as a [Texture3D]. Used by the cross-section and projected renderers when [member albedo_source] is [constant TETRA_COLOR_SOURCE_TEXTURE3D_CELL_UVW_ONLY] or [constant TETRA_COLOR_SOURCE_TEXTURE3D_CELL_UVW_AND_SINGLE].

The offset of the texture map (UV map or UVW map) applied to the base color or albedo 3D texture used for coloring the mesh. This is only used when [member albedo_source] is set to use a [Texture3D], and only when the texture transform mode is set to [constant Material4D.TEXTURE_TRANSFORM_MODE_PER_CHANNEL]. This offset controls the texture map, not the texture itself. An offset of (0.25, 0.25, 0.25) will add this value to all texture coordinates, making a texture coordinate of zero start at a quarter of the way into the texture, which visually shifts the texture in the opposite direction of the offset. This is equivalent to Godot's [member BaseMaterial3D.uv1_offset] property, but is specific to the albedo material channel.

The scale of the texture map (UV map or UVW map) applied to the base color or albedo 3D texture used for coloring the mesh. This is only used when [member albedo_source] is set to use a [Texture3D], and only when the texture transform mode is set to [constant Material4D.TEXTURE_TRANSFORM_MODE_PER_CHANNEL]. This scale controls the texture map, not the texture itself. A scale of (2, 2, 2) will make the texture map cover the texture twice as many times on each axis, which has the effect of tiling the texture in a 2x2x2 pattern, making each visual copy of the texture appear half the size. This is equivalent to Godot's [member BaseMaterial3D.uv1_scale] property, but is specific to the albedo material channel.

Gets the offset of the texture map (UV map or UVW map) applied to all material channels (albedo, emissive, normal, ORM, etc). This is only used when the texture transform mode is set to [constant Material4D.TEXTURE_TRANSFORM_MODE_ALL_CHANNELS] and at least one channel uses a 3D texture. This offset controls the texture map, not the texture itself. An offset of (0.25, 0.25, 0.25) will add this value to all texture coordinates, making a texture coordinate of zero start at a quarter of the way into the texture, which visually shifts the texture in the opposite direction of the offset. This is equivalent to Godot's [member BaseMaterial3D.uv1_offset] property.

Gets the offset of the texture map (UV map or UVW map) applied to all material channels (albedo, emissive, normal, ORM, etc). This is only used when the texture transform mode is set to [constant Material4D.TEXTURE_TRANSFORM_MODE_ALL_CHANNELS] and at least one channel uses a 3D texture. This scale controls the texture map, not the texture itself. A scale of (2, 2, 2) will make the texture map cover the texture twice as many times on each axis, which has the effect of tiling the texture in a 2x2x2 pattern, making each visual copy of the texture appear half the size. This is equivalent to Godot's [member BaseMaterial3D.uv1_scale] property.

Gets the texture transform mode, which determines how the texture transform is applied to the various material channels. Texture transforms are only useful when the material uses 3D textures, such as when [member albedo_source] is set to use a [Texture3D]. See [enum Material4D.TextureTransformMode] for options.

constants.constant: Indicates the color source is a single color for the entire tetrahedral mesh.
Indicates the color source is the color array where each item is used for a vertex.
Indicates the color source is the color array where each item is used for a cell.
Indicates the color source is a 3D texture which cells read based on their UVW coordinates.
Indicates the color source is a 4D texture which cells read based on their local space 4D coordinates.
Indicates the color source is the color array where each item is used for a vertex, modulated by a single color.
Indicates the color source is the color array where each item is used for a cell, modulated by a single color.
Indicates the color source is a 3D texture which cells read based on their UVW coordinates, modulated by a single color.
Indicates the color source is a 4D texture which cells read based on their local space 4D coordinates, modulated by a single color.
